title: Half Moon watch - handoff scratch
content:
Quick notes for whoever's picking up Half-Moon watch (overnight). This is a scratchpad — lots of TODOs and unresolved items below. Keep copy/pasting into the official runbook when stable.

Shift summary (last 6h):
- 00:10: small latency blip on hosted-api-us-west (p95 ~ 980ms) tied to model A quantization job that was hitting nodes; resolved by routing to fallback-small-ctx.
- 01:30: increased retry rate from one user org (org-omega) causing queue growth; applied per-customer rate-limiter (temp) and opened ORCHESTRATION-2121.
- 03:45: disk pressure on dedsec-03 (dedicated pool) — reclaimed by evicting non-active checkpoints.

Open items to track:
- Investigate recurring p95 bumps after >512 token seqs (suspect kernel selection path). Ticket: JIRA-4520.
- Auto-eviction threshold seems aggressive for dedsec pools. Marcus to add metrics instrumentation.

Active toggles / temporary mitigations in place:
- fallback-model-routing enabled for model-A: requests > 600ms now routed to model-A-quant-lite.
- per-customer soft-qps: org-omega set to 60rps. (Revert once ORCHESTRATION-2121 fixed)

Quick diagnostic checklist (order I use):
1) Check alerts page: https://grafana.redwood-inc/alerts (filter alertname~"latency|queue")
2) Confirm nodes healthy: kubectl --context=prod-west get pods -n inference -o wide | grep -E "dedsec|hosted"
3) Look at recently-deployed PRs: `gh pr list --repo redwood-inference/inference-runtime --state merged --search "last 12h"`
4) If p95 high and CPU pinned: check `top` on that pod and `nvidia-smi` on node (dedicated pools).

Fast remediation steps (if model serving unresponsive):
- Soft fallback: flip routing to model-A-quant-lite from Console -> Routes -> Edit policy -> add cost-priority fallback. (Console path quicker for emergency)
- Hard restart (only if pod stuck >10m): `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker --namespace=inference --context=prod-west --selector pool=dedsec-03`
- Clear KV prefix cache for suspicious tenant: run `scripts/evict-kv-prefix.sh tenant/org-omega` (this is temporary; evicting will raise cold starts).

Escalation contacts:
- First: Lina Patel (oncall-eng) slack: @lina (mobile 415-555-0198)
- Second: Marcus Chen (infra lead) slack: @mchen (mobile 650-555-0127)
- Pager: eng-sre rotation (call sequence in OpsConfluence)

Notes to self / TODOs before promoting to shared runbook:
- Draft a short blurb explaining safe rollback for quantized kernels.
- Add exact Prometheus queries for p50/p95/p99 used in alerts.
- Replace local script references with links to jobs in infra repo.

Random troubleshooting snippets (keep handy):
- See active requests by pod: `kubectl exec -it svc/inference-proxy --namespace=inference -- curl -s http://localhost:8080/debug/requests | jq .'`
- Restart model server gracefully: `curl -XPOST http://{pod-ip}:8000/reload-model?force=true` (only after checking in-flight tokens)

Later followups (not urgent):
- Add canary that simulates >700 tokens to validate kernel selection.
- Measure cold-start penalty from kv-evict script (we're seeing ~300-450ms extra p95).

If you're unsure about anything, DM me on slack (@ava.martinez) — I'll be awake for another hour. Leaving this here as the ephemeral log for tomorrow's ops sync.

-- Ava
